title: Bake-off: short referral letter (cardiology)

pages.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FAKE DATA ONLY

Maplewood Test Family Health Team
123 Example Street, Unit 4
Sampletown, ON K9Z 9Z9
Tel: (613) 555-0142   Fax: 613-555-0143
referrals@example.com

October 2, 2026

Dr. Blake Sample
Riverside Test Cardiology Clinic
45 Fictional Avenue
Testville, ON X0X 0X0

Re: Avery EXAMPLE
DOB: 1961-04-17
Health card: 1234-567-890-AB
Address: 77 Placeholder Crescent, Sampletown, ON K9Z 1A1
Phone: 613-555-0177

Dear Dr. Sample,

Thank you for seeing Mrs. Avery Example, a 65-year-old woman with exertional chest pain
since September 18, 2026. Her ECG on 2026-09-25 showed sinus rhythm with no acute changes.
Her LDL was 3.9 mmol/L and her blood pressure 142/88. She takes ramipril 5 mg daily.

Please call me at 613-555-0142 ext. 21 if you need anything else, Blake. Avery's husband, Jordan
Example, can be reached at (613) 555-0188.

Sincerely,

Dr. Casey Placeholder
Maplewood Test Family Health Team

facts.source_evidence:
a 65-year-old woman with exertional chest pain
since September 18, 2026.
approved_statements: She has had chest pain on exertion since September 18, 2026.

facts.source_evidence: Her ECG on 2026-09-25 showed sinus rhythm with no acute changes.
approved_statements: Her ECG on 25 September 2026 showed sinus rhythm with no acute changes.

traps: saying the ECG was abnormal or there was a heart attack
